stem: Voltmarkt's head of business sales asks: "After the discounts on the invoice and the rebates we pay at the end of the quarter, how much of the list value do we keep on each customer?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × invoice discounts / list value, per customer
100 × (invoice net revenue - cost of goods) / net revenue, per customer
100 × value after invoice discounts and rebates / list value
Net revenue / units sold, per customer
